EDITORIAL NOTES

Text and translation notes

  1. Emanuel Tov’s 2023 comparison distinguishes MT/SP ‘sons of Israel’ from 4Q37 ‘sons of God’. This is his published evidence report, not a new reading of a manuscript photograph by this project.
  2. Ancient Greek witnesses also differ. A translation cannot automatically establish one exact Hebrew antecedent. Preservation of a variant phrase is distinct from preservation of the whole verse.
  3. Counter-check: the Israel tradition must also be evaluated; an older artifact alone does not settle priority. The decision remains Open pending direct reading, independence and translation-technique checks.
